name: ruby-emergency-blood-platform
description: Ruby - Emergency Blood Donor Matching and Coordination Platform

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.demo: npm run build --prefix client && npm run dev --prefix server
scripts.app: npm run build --prefix client && npm start --prefix server
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:check && npm run migrate
